correctness.rationale: Exact tail-head bijection for induced incidence matchings; necessary and sufficient one-edge-extension criterion that all unused originals with unused opposite neighbors occur as heads; when both classes unselected are nonempty this is exactly two independent surjections, counted by u!S(b,u) and v!S(a,v). Boundary families yield q^p and p^q. Construct every possible interior size using u=1 and v varying from 1 to p-1; derivation includes p=q=2. Standalone adjacency exhaustive checker covers all edge subsets up to the proven maximum cardinality in nine graph instances, 2,191,336 checked candidates, and exact coefficients match; finite experiments are corroborative only.

value.rationale: The coefficientwise exact polynomial classifies every maximal induced matching in an infinite natural two-parameter graph family; its maximality mechanism requires two surjections, unlike generic matching-count identities. Exact support is disjoint when p<q-1 and yields unbounded forbidden intermediate cardinalities in connected girth-eight bipartite graphs already with p=2. These features are not determined by scalar matching numbers or graph-order upper bounds.
